component.name: OpenWave
component.summary: The audio mixing matrix for Linux

description.p: Per-app mixes with per-mix outputs, plus native control of Elgato Wave hardware — the Wave XLR interface (original and MK.2/XLR Dock) and the Wave:3 microphone. A reverse-engineered replacement for Elgato Wave Link, built with GTK4 and libadwaita on PipeWire.

Sources are rows, mixes are columns, and each cell is how much of that source the mix receives. Applications are matched by name, hardware microphones get their own rows automatically, microphone groups keep one mic live at a time, every mix can feed its own output device or be captured as a virtual microphone, and levels survive a reboot.
